launch.title: Remove Duplicates from a Sorted Array | InterviewReel
launch.description: Keep each distinct value once in a sorted input array. Compare nums[r] with the last kept value nums[w-1], not the previous read slot after swaps. Return k; only the first k entries form the sorted unique result. The tail is ignored. O(n) time and O(1) extra space. Practice target: 1 second for up to 100000 sorted integers. Original deterministic visuals with AI-generated narration.
launch.socialCaption: Sorted input, one unique prefix. The comparison that matters is against the last KEPT value. Try [1,1,1,2]. #DSA #CodingInterview #TwoPointers #InterviewReel
launch.pinnedComment: For sorted nums = [1,1,1,2], what are k and the unique prefix? Why compare with nums[w-1] rather than nums[r-1] after swaps?
